## Validity of Test Results

The most critical finding in this report is that **test results are considered invalid**. The PAI validity indices indicated that Kira did not attend appropriately when responding to items. The report notes several possible explanations:

- Reading difficulties
- Careless or random responding
- Marked confusion
- Failure to follow test instructions

Because of this, **no clinical interpretation is provided** by the automated report. All profile data and indices should be interpreted with extreme caution or disregarded for clinical decision-making.

See [[concepts/validity-and-response-styles]] and [[concepts/random-responding]] for broader context on validity screening in psychological testing.
